rules: No browser, context, profile broker, vault, database or provider operations in this stage
Input JSON text or plain owned object; no executable tags, unsafe prototypes, accessors or dangerous object keys
Only declared cookie/origin/localStorage properties; finite valid cookie expiry, typed flags and SameSite
Origins must be canonical HTTP(S) origins inside the supplied approved origin set; cookie host must match an approved host after leading-dot and case normalization
Reject duplicate origin, duplicate localStorage keys and duplicate cookie name/domain/path identities
Return a detached validated value and never include input contents in failure text
This parser does not prove successful authentication; capture must later reject an empty or non-transferable result
outstanding: Private credential execution port is not yet specified/wired
Current approvedAuthState origins injection has implicit goto; must be removed or granted before any runtime auth-state import
Full grant/record/budget/lock/OTP/capture execution and current-lease retry atomicity remain unverified
